name: Crimson Ninja
source_text: FLIP: Select 1 Trap Card on the field and destroy it. If the selected card is Set, pick up and see the card. If it is a Trap Card, it is destroyed. If it is a Spell Card, return it to its original position.
notes: The engine knows the printed type, so only a Trap is selectable.
